display_information.name: Tusk
display_information.description: Local Slack bot in Transcriber. Paste a supported link for 👀; /tusk help and status.
display_information.long_description: Tusk is a Socket Mode Slack bot that runs locally inside the Transcriber menu-bar app on your Mac. No public URL, tunnel, or cloud worker. Invite @Tusk to an allowlisted channel, paste a YouTube URL, and Tusk adds 👀 then a threaded summary (or transcript file). @Tusk questions in that thread answer only from that video. /tusk help and /tusk status report whether the Mac app is connected. channels:history delivers every message in public channels Tusk has joined; Tusk ignores DMs, private channels, and other workspaces. External authors are always denied. Only internal members can trigger Tusk in a listed shared channel.

slash_commands.description: Show Tusk help or whether the Mac app is connected
